---
title: "w03_Task1"
---
```{r}
library(gapminder)
library(tidyverse)
```

```{r}
trend <- gapminder %>% 
  filter(country != "Kuwait") %>% 
  group_by(continent, year) %>% 
  summarize(
    weighted_gdpPercap = weighted.mean(gdpPercap, pop),
    total_pop = sum(pop),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
```

```{r}
ggplot(
  data = gapminder %>% filter(country != "Kuwait"),
  mapping = aes(x = year, y = gdpPercap, color = continent, group = country)) +
  geom_point(aes(size = pop), alpha = 0.3) +
  geom_line(alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_line(data = trend,
            aes(
              x = year,
              y = weighted_gdpPercap,
              group = 1
            ),
            color = "black"
            ) +
  geom_point(data = trend,
            aes(
              x = year,
              y = weighted_gdpPercap,
              size = total_pop / 100000,
              group = 1
            ),
            color = "black"
            ) +
  facet_wrap(~ continent, nrow = 1) +
  scale_y_continuous(trans = "sqrt") +
  theme_bw()
```
